paper_title: Lattice QCD input for axion cosmology
notes: Pure-theory lattice QCD paper. Its headline result is a lower bound on the QCD axion mass, m_a >= (14.6 +- 0.1) micro-eV, derived from the cosmological overclosure argument (misalignment mechanism) for the PQ-breaking-after-inflation scenario, using first-principles lattice input for the temperature-dependent topological susceptibility of SU(3) Yang-Mills. This is a cosmological/theoretical bound on the axion mass (equivalently on f_a), not an experimental or observational exclusion of any axion coupling. It does not correspond to a curve in any of the canonical (mass, coupling) planes and is not a measured limit, so is_new_limit is false and no data points are reported.
